name: review-loop
description: AI-driven code review with independent adversarial review, automated quality polish, and multi-language static analysis. 12 agents, 5 skills, full Plan-Execute-Review-Polish pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Plan-Execute-Review workflows, including explicit paired-session opt-in
interface.longDescription: review-loop supports the legacy plan → execute → review → delivery workflow and an explicit paired-session coordinator skill for work items in other repositories. The paired-session entry remains opt-in during staged migration. Codex marketplace install exposes the five Stage 1 native skills (guide, plan, execute, review-loop, paired-session) under `.agents/skills/`, paired with the reviewer + executor agents at `.codex/agents/*.toml`.
